# C app results (generated by tools/make_c_results.py from results/c_app/*)

Per-image `invoke()` latency over the 50 held-out sample images (one inference each, after one warm-up inference).
Fewer samples than the 200-run loop in results.md, so treat the medians as indicative.

| Config | Median (ms) | Min (ms) | Max (ms) | Warm-up inference (ms) | images | top-1 vs ground truth |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NPU | 3.54 | 3.54 | 3.56 | 3.59 | 50 | 0.72 |
| CPU 1 thread (no XNNPACK) | 67.91 | 67.78 | 68.83 | 74.14 | 50 | 0.72 |
| CPU 2 threads (no XNNPACK) | 49.10 | 48.89 | 53.53 | 55.15 | 50 | 0.72 |
| CPU 1 thread, XNNPACK | 40.37 | 40.07 | 40.87 | 46.53 | 50 | 0.72 |
| CPU 2 threads, XNNPACK | 22.77 | 22.47 | 23.75 | 28.84 | 50 | 0.72 |

## C app vs Python app (same model, same images)

- NPU: C and Python top-1 identical on 48 of 50 images; differing: n02102040_5802.JPEG (C skunk / Py Tibetan mastiff); n02979186_40.JPEG (C cassette player / Py tape player)
- CPU 1 thread, XNNPACK: C and Python top-1 identical on 47 of 50 images; differing: n02102040_5802.JPEG (C skunk / Py Tibetan mastiff); n02979186_40.JPEG (C tape player / Py cassette player); n03425413_13821.JPEG (C gas pump / Py safe)
